meta.name: Gariahater Ganglords 720p
meta.description:
Buchku comes to Kolkata for higher studies, and starts staying with his cousin Jonny and his friend Bunty. Little does he know, that they are gangsters.

Complete series. On your server: S1 10/10

videos.title: Bukey aaye bhaai
videos.overview: Jonny and Bunty mess up a murder and reach Jonny's aunt's place. She tells that Buchku, his cousin brother will be staying with them for higher studies.

videos.title: Bandit der Bandparty
videos.overview: Jonny's childhood flame Monalisa comes to Kolkata to shoot for a documentary on Bangla Band. Jonny decides to impress her by creating a fake rock band.

videos.title: Deadbody-r saathey date
videos.overview: Bunty receives a letter from a friend who asks for a favor: to hide a dead body at their place for a few days. Meanwhile, Buchku is smitten by classmate Bipasha.

videos.title: Buchku jokhon birpurush
videos.overview: A dead body, Buchku, and Bipasha - all are in one apartment. Who will save the Ganglords now?

videos.title: Ekti Kyalaney Kidnapping er Kahini
videos.overview: As celebrations continue, Buchku, gets kidnapped by Haatkata Haradhan, nemesis of Jonny and Bunty, who asks for a large ransom.

videos.title: Super-sonkot-e Superstar
videos.overview: The Ganglords execute their dream project of kidnapping a film star. But things take a different turn as opposed to their own expectations.

videos.title: Ganglords der G**re baansh
videos.overview: Buchku starts getting into the good books of Bipasha, while Bunty is detected with a disease. He wants Jonny to train Buchku in their profession.

videos.title: Biography-r bisri hyal
videos.overview: As their missions fail every time, Bunty and Jonny request an author to write a biography on their lives, that can help them become successful gangsters.

videos.title: Mafia ra jokhon Meniberal
videos.overview: The author agrees to write only on one condition: she wants to include the names of a few serial killers, starting with her own name. Is she an author for real?

videos.title: Season seshey Satyanarayan
videos.overview: It's Buchku's birthday and everyone is invited to the surprise party. While they are celebrating, they forget to invite the dreaded Haatkaata Haradhan.
